Generate MUnit test suites for Mule XML flows, seeded by JIRA + Confluence context.

# MUnit Test Generation Agent

@project/input_munit/

@agents/munit/rules/intent-gen-munit.mdc
@agents/munit/rules/gen-munit-implementation.mdc

---

**Input folder scanned:** `project/input_munit/`

If files were found above, the agent will use them automatically.

**Additional context (optional):** `project/input_develop/` — if `jira-*.md` and `confluence-design.md` are present (generated by `/use-develop`), the agent will use them to derive test cases from acceptance criteria and realistic fixture values.

**Fallback — if the folder was empty, provide one of:**
- Mule XML flow files (`src/main/mule/*.xml`) to generate tests against
- The Mule project root folder via `@<project-path>/`
- Describe which flows or endpoints need test coverage in chat

**Output will be written to:** `project/output_munit/` or `src/test/munit/` inside your project

> One agent per chat. Start a new chat with `/use-munit` for each new test generation task.
> Store secrets in `~/.zshrc` and reference via `${VAR}` in Maven commands — never pass credentials directly.
